in_hebrew.name: ביצ
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Betz is derived from the Hebrew word 'beteshet' which means 'swarming locusts'. In the context of the Bible, the name Betz may be used figuratively to represent a large, destructive force or an overwhelming crowd.

in_greek.name: Βητζ
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Betz is derived from the Hebrew name 'Beth-zeth'. 'Beth' means 'house' and 'zeth' means 'abundance', so Beth-zeth could be interpreted as 'house of abundance' or 'abundant house'.

in_latin.name: Betzia
in_latin.long_meaning: There is no direct translation of the name Betz into Latin. However, it is possible to find Latinized forms of the Greek name Betz, such as Betzia.
